_comment: Hand-written demo fixture, matched to the scripted input in docs/demo-script.md. Not model output — tuned by hand so the reveal lands exactly as intended. Replace with a recorded live response once the prompt is tuned.

profile.summary: a two-person bakery in Bandra taking custom cake orders over Instagram
profile._industryNote: Titan's 16-industry taxonomy, which api/profile.ts constrains the model to. Was 'Bakery & confectionery' - a label matching neither Titan's taxonomy nor Neo's builder categories, so the handoff URL never carried an industryKey. See docs/data-findings.md section 6.

_nextQuestionIdNote: The model's suggestion for what to ask first. The engine overrules it if the signal is already resolved, so this can never break the flow. 'channel' is chosen here because the free text already mentions Instagram — asking it back makes the tool look like it was listening.
meterGuess: bakeries taking cake orders over Instagram

channel.prompt: Where do cake orders reach you today?
channel.sub: Pick all that apply — most bakeries have more than one.

social.label: Instagram and WhatsApp DMs
social.hint: Where the cake orders live now
social.meter: who take cake orders in DMs

personal.label: A personal email address
personal.meter: who still use a personal inbox

site.label: I already have a website
site.meter: who already have a bakery site

import.sub: Existing mail or contacts from how you take orders now.
import.placeholder: Something else you'd want moved across?

none.label: No, I'll start fresh
none.meter: who are starting their mail fresh

emails.label: Yes, my emails
emails.meter: who are bringing their mail across

both.label: Emails and contacts
both.meter: who are moving mail and contacts

surface.sub: You can add the other half later.

both.label: Email and a site
both.meter: who want mail and a cake site

client.prompt: What do you use for mail right now?

gmail.label: Gmail
gmail.meter: who run the bakery from Gmail

outlook.label: Outlook
outlook.meter: who run the bakery from Outlook

none.label: Nothing set up yet
none.meter: who have no bakery inbox yet

team.prompt: How many email addresses do you need?
team.sub: Addresses, not people — hello@ and orders@ count.

sells.sub: Changes what a cake site needs to do.
sells.placeholder: Anything else about how you get paid?

yes.label: Yes, I take orders or payments

reveal._domainsNote: Availability and price are overridden at runtime by the live DomScan lookup (/api/domains). These values are the FALLBACK shown only when that call fails. They are set to the measured live figures rather than invented ones, so the fallback path can never contradict the happy path in front of an audience. The stem must match domainStem above — the lookup keys off it.

domains.name: proofandbutter.co
domains.note: Shorter, if you want room to grow beyond cakes

mailboxes.label: So cake orders stop living in your DMs

site.headline: Celebration cakes, made to order in Bandra
site.subhead: Two bakers, one oven, and a waiting list worth joining.
